definition: Bakeware and baking (cake tins, cake cases, cookie cutters, baking/jam sets, jelly moulds); tableware (mugs, cups, bowls, jugs, teapots, teacups, tea sets, cake stands); cutlery; kitchen tools (scales, measuring spoons, spice/biscuit tins, recipe boxes, tea-bag plates); food containers (lunch boxes, snack boxes, popcorn holders); and kitchen/laundry linens (oven gloves, tea towels, aprons, washing-up gloves, peg bags, clothes pegs).

Decorative and functional homeware: hanging hearts/decorations, ornaments, wicker hearts/stars, trellises, doves, lovebird decorations, picture/photo frames, card holders, hooks/coat racks, drawer knobs, trinket boxes, money banks, mini chests/cabinets, storage boxes, decorative word blocks, clocks and doormats.
Tea-light and candle holders (hanging, zinc, glass, jar, star, angel), candles, lanterns, night lights and decorative string lights.
Carriers: jumbo/lunch/charlotte/shopper/shoulder/storage/recycling/picnic bags, toy tidies, picnic baskets and printed carrier bags.
Soft comfort and furnishing textiles: hot water bottles, hand warmers and cushions.
Cards, gift tags, gift wrap, ribbons, paper-chain kits (non-Christmas), notebooks, pencils, crayons, chalk sticks, colouring/craft sets, modelling clay, sewing/knitting kits.
Games (cards, dominoes, bingo, snakes & ladders), spinning tops, skipping ropes, catch-cup games, harmonicas, model gliders, dolls and soft felt toys, play sets.
Any item explicitly Christmas or Scandinavian-Christmas themed (napkins, cake cases, paper chains, wooden hearts/stars, ribbons).
Garden and outdoor items: kneeling pads, plant ladders and planters.
Metal signs, chalkboards/blackboards and memo boards (display and messaging surfaces).
Wearable and personal accessories: parasols, umbrellas, silk fans, jewellery boxes, coat hangers, key fobs.
Party goods: bunting, party/birthday candles, cocktail parasols and disposable party tableware (paper napkins, plates, cups, doilies, decorative tissues).
Items that do not fit a defined family, e.g. novelty plasters in a tin.
